articleTitle: A UAV Object Detection Algorithm Based on Improved YOLOX
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Intelligent Robotics and Control Engineering (IRCE)
abstract: In aerial photography, UAV will cause small objects and mutual occlusion between objects, bringing enormous challenges to the current one-stage object detection algorithm. In order to solve the above problems, this paper proposes a YOLOX-TBP one-stage object detection algorithm. Based on YOLOX-l, the algorithm adds a prediction head to detect objects of different scales to improve the detection effect of small objects. At the same time, the partial convolution of the backbone network is replaced by Transformer to improve the global information of the model, and a weighted bi-directional feature pyramid network (BiFPN) is introduced to improve the multi-scale feature fusion effect through the method of self-learning weights. The final experiments show that the MAP of the YOLOX-TBP model tested on the VisDrone-DET 2021 dataset reaches 40.27%, which is 0.84% higher than the previous SOTA method (DBNet).

articleTitle: Gait Prediction and Assist Control of Lower Limb Exoskeleton Based on Inertia Measurement Unit
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Intelligent Robotics and Control Engineering (IRCE)
abstract: The lower limb exoskeleton is a wearable robot with wide application, such as helping the elderly and the disabled, military, etc. This paper focuses on the design and control of the lower exoskeleton based on Inertia Measurement Unit (IMU), which can realize trajectory control, active and passive follow-up control and predictive control, thus realizing the assistance to the wearer and reducing the wearer's sense of load. The kinematic mechanism of human lower limbs is analyzed and the kinematic model is established by using standard D-H coordinate transformation method. The mechanical structure of exoskeleton is designed and its hardware system is built. LabVIEW software is selected as upper computer. The physical model of knee joint motor is established and its transfer function is derived. PID control strategy is selected and target trajectory for closed-loop control of external skeleton is set to achieve the specified trajectory. Gait movements of three participants were collected and analyzed using inertial sensors. Machine learning method is used to predict gait data through ARIMA model.

articleTitle: Programmable Microcontroller Based Power Management Module for Batteryless intermittent Computing Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Intelligent Robotics and Control Engineering (IRCE)
abstract: The maturity of energy harvesting technologies and low-power microcontrollers creates the prospect of developing batteryless computing for wireless sensor networks and i.o.t applications. One of the challenges mitigating the sustainability of batteryless computing is the intermittence and regulation of harvested energy which hinders the prolonged execution of batteryless computing applications. This paper aims to propose a novel power management module by leveraging a programmable microcontroller using an open-source, energy-aware software framework to implement a low-cost power management module for batteryless intermittent computing solutions. The design and implementation consist of integrating DC to DC power regulating topology and the characteristics of a general purpose, ultra-low power mixed signal microcontroller to implement a power management module that regulates DC output voltage and offers many more functionalities for batteryless intermittent computing applications.

articleTitle: Research and Realization of Automobile Remote Calibration Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Intelligent Robotics and Control Engineering (IRCE)
abstract: Calibration is an important process for the on-board controller to optimize and adjust software parameters in the development process to meet various performances. In some cases where there are many calibration parameters, the calibration process is complicated, the distance is long, especially during the epidemic, travel is inconvenient, remote calibration is one of the important technical methods to improve the calibration efficiency and accuracy. In this paper, a method of remote calibration using XCP calibration protocol and TCP/IP network transmission protocol is proposed. The whole vehicle controller is used as the sample to be calibrated, and the calibration platform is built with INCA. Through the test, the system can effectively perform remote measurement, debugging and calibration.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Substation Operation Safety Management and Control System Based on Three-dimensional Modeling and Composite Positioning
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Intelligent Robotics and Control Engineering (IRCE)
abstract: This paper presents a substation operation safety management and control system based on three-dimensional modeling and composite positioning technology. Which is based on difficult management and control of operators, vehicles and tools and instruments, low efficiency, narrow dimension and blind spots in the current substation field operation. The system takes three stages before, during and after the on-site operation of the substation as the key points. Firstly, the laser point cloud and BIM are used for 3D modeling. Then use Beidou and UWB composite positioning technology, combined with substation intelligent access control, video monitoring, work ticket and other subsystems. Realize the functions of personnel and vehicle qualification review before substation operation, real-time positioning of personnel and tools and instruments during operation, recovery of safety measures after operation and real-time monitoring of items left behind. The system has been successfully deployed and applied in a 220kV substation in Guizhou, which greatly improves the efficiency of on-site operation safety management and control of the substation.

articleTitle: Design and Fabrication of a Sensorized Soft Actuator via Embedded 3D Printing
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Intelligent Robotics and Control Engineering (IRCE)
abstract: The application of soft sensors significantly enhances the functionality of soft robotics. However, most sensorized soft robots need to be fabricated by multi-step manual methods, which are cumbersome and time-consuming. Here, we design a sensorized pneumatic actuator and print it entirely without any molds or sacrificial support structures using multi-material embedded 3D (EMB3D) printing. This effective and economic strategy achieves the integrated manufacturing of the network of actuators and sensors and simplifies the design and fabrication process of soft robotics. The finite element analysis (FEA) simulations of actuator bending behaviors are conducted and the comparisons between simulations and experiments verify the effectiveness of EMB3D printing. The soft strain sensor integrated on the top surface can detect the bending angle of the actuator with good linearity and sensitivity. Furthermore, a sensorized soft gripper assembled with two printed actuators is used to grasp objects of different sizes. The integrated sensor can estimate the grasping state and estimate the size of the object potentially, which is essential for closed-loop feedback control.

articleTitle: Research on Upper Limb Rehabilitation Action Recognition Method of Unsupervised Contrast Learning Based on Time-domain Multi-scale Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Intelligent Robotics and Control Engineering (IRCE)
abstract: Vision-based action recognition technology plays a major role in human-robot interaction during the upper limb rehabilitation training of stroke patients with the aid of an upper limb rehabilitation robot. To address the problems that supervised learning requires a large amount of manual labeling, which is time-consuming and inefficient, in this paper, we present an upper limb rehabilitation action recognition method of unsupervised contrast learning based on multi-scale feature fusion and we improves SimCLR by replacing the single-scale CNN with Inception V1 which contains the multi-scale feature fusion module and increasing the temporal dimension based on the idea of the expanded convolutional neural network to fully extract the Spatio-temporal feature information of the actions. The experiment results show that unsupervised contrast learning based on time-domain multi-scale feature fusion achieves recognition accuracy of 92.59% for 8 upper limb rehabilitation actions without extensive manual labeling. It can help patients recover their motor functions through upper limb rehabilitation training.

articleTitle: A Multi-scale Temporal Convolutional Network-based Method for sEMG Upper Limb Motion Intention Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Intelligent Robotics and Control Engineering (IRCE)
abstract: Surface electromyographys (sEMG) is an electrical signal generated by human muscle contraction, it is easy to obtain, less invasive, and contains rich motor information. It is widely used in medical and rehabilitation fields. In this paper, we propose a motion intention recognition method based on a multi-scale temporal convolutional network(TCN) model. We extract the time domain features and frequency domain features of each channel of sEMG to form a feature vector. Then we use TCN of different sizes to extract features of different scales for feature fusion to improve the recognition accuracy. The experimental results show that the average recognition accuracy is 85.1% for 12 upper limb movements, which is better than the traditional machine learning methods and single-scale TCN, verifying the superiority of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Deep Q-learning Sampling Based on Advantages
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Intelligent Robotics and Control Engineering (IRCE)
abstract: Deep Q-learning (DQN) has shown recent success on a wide range of complicated sequential decision-making issues, especially in the classic control area. However, in most DQN training, the sampling policies, particularly the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\epsilon$</tex>-greedy policy and its derivation rules, produce noise erroneously due to the unsteadiness and unreliability of Q values utilized for searching for optimum actions. We begin with a fundamental hypothesis: complete advantages-based exploitation may be employed to help in successful exploration, and the gap between advantages on outstanding and poor actions tends to extend during the early phases of training before stabilizing. We then present a novel DQN architecture with a superior sampling policy that is totally and directly based on advantage values. This new DQN is named A-sampling DQN, and it requires minor code changes based on the original DQN codes. In most cases, A-sampling DQN and its derivatives outperformed the traditional DQN method.

articleTitle: Bio-inspired Vacuum Driven Soft Robot for Esophageal Obstruction Removal
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Intelligent Robotics and Control Engineering (IRCE)
abstract: Esophagus foreign body obstruction is a common surgical emergency for which no dedicated extraction device exists. The paper presents a simple soft robotic medical device specifically designed for the removal of the esophagus foreign bodies, which has significant clinical application prospects. The biomimetic design of the soft robot is based on the movement characteristics of a chameleon's tongue during predation, consisting of a top recess and a surrounding protrusion. The top recess depresses downwards to form a vacuum zone, which sucks in the obstruction and creates a fold to achieve shape locking. The protrusions on both sides bend inwards, aiding the clamping of obstruction. The soft robot adapts to grasp obstructions with different physical characteristics. Design concept is introduced and structural optimization is conducted by finite element simulation. The experimental results on three optimized prototype demonstrate the effectiveness of the soft robot design and show good potential for its commercialization in future medical field.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Household Separated-Waste Containers Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Intelligent Robotics and Control Engineering (IRCE)
abstract: The separation of domestic waste is of great significance to the establishment of a good living environment and the maximum utilization of resources in cities. Besides, separation and recycling from the family has gradually attracted the attention of relevant government departments and researchers because the family is the source of domestic waste. Thus, in this paper, in view of the problems of the lack of knowledge of domestic waste separation and the lack of source separation, the overall design scheme of intelligent household separated-waste containers was formulated by using the technical characteristics of machine vision and the mechanical structure of household waste containers. An intelligent waste container system with image acquisition module, image processing module, waste separation module and control module was built, and the hardware was optimized and analyzed, and the design system was studied in practice.

articleTitle: Finite Difference Method Based on Node Set Vector for Numerical Computation of Poisson Equation
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Intelligent Robotics and Control Engineering (IRCE)
abstract: A novel finite difference method based on node set vectors for two-dimensional Poisson equation is proposed in this paper, the method, called as node set vector FDM (NSV-FDM), can be applied to structured or unstructured grids, and be used to deal with boundary conditions naturally as finite element method. Studies on basic discrete scheme of NSV-FDM, the second order discrete scheme of interior node and boundary node are investigated in detail in this paper, numerical computation of two samples with different distribution functions are also carried out, the results verify that NSV-FDM is effective for numerical computation of Poisson equation.

articleTitle: A Gravitational Energy Storage Mechanism with Carbon Capture Function
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Intelligent Robotics and Control Engineering (IRCE)
abstract: In this paper, a tower energy storage system using gravity energy storage technology is proposed, which combines the energy storage system with the direct CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> capture technology in the air. The system encompasses a tower crane with double booms, a block filled with CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> adsorbent, an integrated generator/motor, and a desorption reactor. It can store excess electricity when the renewable energy grid generates excess electricity and release the stored power in case of insufficient power generation, design a specific desorption reactor, use the temperature swing adsorption process to complete the CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> desorption, storage and regeneration process of the adsorbent, thereby providing an effective solution for solving the problem of renewable energy utilization.

articleTitle: Dynamic Theta Oscillation in Frontotemporal systems Process Object and Time in Working Memory
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Intelligent Robotics and Control Engineering (IRCE)
abstract: In working memory (WM), we need coordination of multiple brain regions to process different types of information, such as prefrontal cortex (PFC) and medial temporal lobe (MTL, including the hippocampus) involve in processing of object task and temporal task. In both tasks, however, it is unclear at which period PFC and MTL function in memory. We addressed this question by presenting object task memory and temporal task memory to eight subjects with stereotaxic electrodes implanted in PFC and MTL. The results showed significant increase in theta power in PFC during post-cue (proc) delay phase of temporal task compared to post-cue delay phase of object task. And compared with encoding and maintenance (encmain) phases of object task, theta power in MTL was significantly increased during encmian phases of temporal task. This result suggested that PFC and MTL have temporal specificity in processing object task and temporal task, and this specificity is mainly concentrated in theta frequency band.

articleTitle: Research of Scene Text Detection Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Intelligent Robotics and Control Engineering (IRCE)
abstract: With the development of artificial intelligence, obtaining textual information from natural scenes has become a hot topic. There are still huge challenges for curved text and arbitrary orientation text detection in real-world scenes. In this work, we briefly introduce the development of text detection algorithms in recent years and study a typical lightweight detection algorithm. We have improved the algorithm to different degrees to make it more suitable for detection of the curved text. Finally, we select the three most representative public text datasets for experiments. Experiments conducted on CTW1500, ICDAR2015, and MSRA-TD500 have demonstrated the superiority of this model.

articleTitle: Robust Bipartite Tracking Control for Multi-agent Systems with Co-competition Interactions via the NN-UDE Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Intelligent Robotics and Control Engineering (IRCE)
abstract: This paper focuses on the bipartite consensus tracking problem of multi-agent systems with co-competition interactions. The dynamics of the leader agent is uncertain for each follower agent and there exist unknown disturbances in the control input channel of followers. To solve this problem, a robust bipartite consensus tracking control scheme is proposed by adopting the NN-UDE approach. NN-UDE is the approximation/estimation structure that includes two components. One component is the neural networks (NNs), which can be used to approximate the uncertainties of leader agent; the other component is the uncertainty and disturbance estimator (UDE), which can estimate the unknown disturbances of follower agents. The effective coupling of NN and UDE can improve the robustness of the system and solve the bipartite consensus tracking control problem. Finally, the simulation results are given to verify the effectiveness of the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of an Inline Threaded Rear Wheel Hub for FSC Racing Cars
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Intelligent Robotics and Control Engineering (IRCE)
abstract: In this paper, to address the problems of inefficiency when dismantling the half-shaft and affecting the stability of the rear suspension of FSC racing cars, the inner cavity of the rear wheel hub is changed to a detachable type by using thread fit while ensuring the original function of the rear hub remains the same. The load values on the rear hub of the racing car under extreme working conditions are calculated, and the three-dimensional model is established by CATIA and the rear hub is analyzed and optimized by ANSYS finite element analysis software for static simulation. The analysis results show that the new rear hub meets the strength requirements and achieves a certain degree of light weight, which is of great significance to improve the performance and maintenance efficiency of the racing car.

articleTitle: Iterative Learning Control for a Constrainted Mobile Vehicle-Manipulator System
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Intelligent Robotics and Control Engineering (IRCE)
abstract: This article focuses on the question of how to cope with the trajectory tracking and constraint handling issues for a flexible mobile vehicle-manipulator system with constant tension under uncertain environment disturbance. Several differential equations are derived to describe the considered mobile vehicle-manipulator system. Through cooperating of PD control and asymmetric barrier Lyapunov function, an iterative learning control tactic is put forward to ensure that the manipulator's vibration is weakened and the position of vehicle and the angular position of joint are both within given limited extent. In addition to theoretical analysis, finally, simulations are also given to demonstrate the validity of proposed control tactic.

articleTitle: Electrodynamic Force and Mechanical Stress Analysis of Cable Brackets under Transient-Steady State Conditions
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Intelligent Robotics and Control Engineering (IRCE)
abstract: This study divides the different force forms of the power cable support into two kinds, the first is steady-state force determined by gravity, electrodynamic effect and construction under normal operation condition, and the second is transient force determined by electrodynamic force and gravity under short-circuit condition. Under the condition of short circuit fault, the force formulae of cable and support components are derived, the characteristics of the maximum transient force of cable support are analyzed, and the force attenuation trend of different phases of cable support and the variation law of maximum force value and initial angle are revealed. On the basis of the above analysis, an 110kV adjustable cable support is designed and the force characteristics are simulated. The results show that the transient mechanical stress is about 2 times of the one under three-phase short-circuit fault with 15 times of steady-state current, the deformation increases by about 50% with a short applied time.

articleTitle: The MATLAB Simulation and the Linear Quadratic Regulator Torque Control of a Series Elastic Actuator for a Rehabilitation Hip Exoskeleton
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Intelligent Robotics and Control Engineering (IRCE)
abstract: Almost the half of mechanical energy of a human gait cycle is generated by a hip joint. Therefore, this paper discusses a rehabilitation hip exoskeleton, starting with the modeling, simulation and ending with controlling its hip joints. A MATLAB based simulation environment with the use of Simscape Multibody toolbox was utilized to design and control the robotic hip exoskeleton. More details of adding a series elastic actuators (SEA) to the hip joints with the mathematical model are presented. However, the linearised mathematical model of the entire exoskeleton was found in simulation software which establish the basic need of controlling hip joints. The trajectory tracking is commonly used of controlling rehabilitation exoskeleton and to ensure a safe and reliable motion tracking methods, two desired torque signals were tested and analysed with the optimal linear quadratic regulator (LQR). The experiments with two torque signals–representing the sit-to-stand (STS) and the walking activity, demonstrated good performance of the motion gait tracking based on torque signals of a healthy person, which is carried out in the simulation environment. Furthermore, some studies in a human robot interaction are also mentioned in this paper.

articleTitle: Design of Stirling Cooler Driving Circuit Based on Fuzzy PID Controller
publicationTitle: 2022 5th International Conference on Intelligent Robotics and Control Engineering (IRCE)
abstract: As stirling coolers are widely used in military, aerospace and other application, the demand for the driving circuits is rapidly increasing. And it has become more urgent to improve the performance of driving circuits, including driving capability, noise control and temperature control accuracy. Therefore, this paper presents the stirling cooler driving circuit based on microcontroller unit (MCU), which adopts the fuzzy proportional-integral-derivative (PID) control algorithm to realize the closed-loop control of the temperature. Firstly, the proposed driving circuit scheme and core devices' selection are introduced in detail. Secondly, the principle and characteristics of the control scheme based on fuzzy PID control algorithm are analyzed and established. Finally, a detailed simulation study in MATLAB/Simulink is performed to investigate the performance of the fuzzy PID controller. The results illustrate that the performance of proposed control approach in comparison to the traditional PID has been greatly improved, with smaller overshoot, lower settling time and better dynamic performance.
